decisions.reason: A burner component that builds on the established radiant-heater business costs little to keep and supports the core range, so the option stays open while demand reveals itself.
The firm presents this electric infrared panel line as a flagship of its electrification direction and it is only a year old, so its value is still uncertain and worth preserving.
The halogen heater has its own page and low incremental cost within the infrared portfolio, and one year gives too little evidence to justify abandoning it.
This multi-model industrial electric hall heater sits close to the core customer base and benefits from growing demand for electric heating, so keeping the option is cheap and promising.
The hydrogen-ready dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world deployment, and it gives a valuable growth option toward low-carbon heating.
